key: An especially fierce sandstorm seems to be raging on ahead...
en: An especially fierce sandstorm seems to be raging on ahead...
ja: 先のほうで　特に　激しい砂嵐が　吹き荒れているようだ……

key: Going farther by foot would be unsafe.
en: Going farther by foot would be unsafe.
ja: このまま　徒歩で　進むのは　危険だ。

key: Well, howdy, partner!
en: Well, howdy, partner!
ja: よう　ご機嫌だな　相棒!

key: We thought we was hearin' some kinda racket,
en: We thought we was hearin' some kinda racket,
ja: 何やら　物音が　するなと　思ってたんだが

key: But we figured it was just the local Steelix givin' it a good tussle again.
en: But we figured it was just the local Steelix givin' it a good tussle again.
ja: どうせ　この辺の　ハガネールが　また　暴れてるだけだろうと　思ってたんだ。

key: Name's Europa. Good to meet ya!
en: Name's Europa. Good to meet ya!
ja: 名前は　エウロパ。よろしくな!

key: As you might imagine, we don't exactly get a whole lot of visitors up here.
en: As you might imagine, we don't exactly get a whole lot of visitors up here.
ja: 想像つくだろうが　ここいらじゃ　訪ねてくる人なんて　そうそう　いないんだ。

key: But, this here's Train Town, as some of us affectionately refer to it.
en: But, this here's Train Town, as some of us affectionately refer to it.
ja: だが　ここは「トレインタウン」って　みんなで　愛着を込めて　呼んでる場所さ。

key: There ain't of many of us. We just a ragtag group who ain't found their place around other people.
en: There ain't of many of us. We just a ragtag group who ain't found their place around other people.
ja: あたしたちは　そんなに　多くない。ただの　他人の中じゃ　居場所を　見つけられなかった　寄せ集めの連中さ。

key: But we got each other here, and that's all we need.
en: But we got each other here, and that's all we need.
ja: でも　ここじゃ　お互いが　いるし　それだけで　十分なんだ。

key: If you lookin' stay a while, why not stay and hang out with everyone?
en: If you lookin' stay a while, why not stay and hang out with everyone?
ja: しばらく　いるつもりなら　みんなと　一緒に　過ごしてみたら　どうだい?

key: EUROPA: There ain't much to live on up here, so we vagabond types gotta be responsible for growin' some of our own food.
en: EUROPA: There ain't much to live on up here, so we vagabond types gotta be responsible for growin' some of our own food.
ja: エウロパ: ここいらじゃ　暮らしていける物が　あんまりないから　あたしたち　流れ者は　自分たちで　食料を　育てなきゃ　いけないんだ。

key: Ain' no small matter either. Sometimes we go hungry, but I'd say it's worth it to have this kinda freedom.
en: Ain' no small matter either. Sometimes we go hungry, but I'd say it's worth it to have this kinda freedom.
ja: 小さな問題じゃ　ないよ。腹を　空かせることも　あるけど　この自由には　それだけの　価値が　あると思うね。

key: By the way, if you need any supplies before headin' back out into the sands, talk to ol' Bouffalant Bill.
en: By the way, if you need any supplies before headin' back out into the sands, talk to ol' Bouffalant Bill.
ja: ところで　砂漠に　戻る前に　物資が　必要なら　バッフロンビルの　じいさんに　話しかけてみな。

key: He should be able to sell you a thing or two.
en: He should be able to sell you a thing or two.
ja: 何かしら　売ってくれる　はずだ。

key: EUROPA: This is kind of our nightly tradition here!
en: EUROPA: This is kind of our nightly tradition here!
ja: エウロパ: これが　ここでの　夜の恒例行事なんだ!

key: When in good company, a little drink doesn't last as long, but the spirits sure go a long way.
en: When in good company, a little drink doesn't last as long, but the spirits sure go a long way.
ja: いい仲間と　一緒だと　少しの酒じゃ　物足りないが　その分　元気は　長持ちするもんさ。

key: MISS PERCY: Unless Bill's around!
en: MISS PERCY: Unless Bill's around!
ja: パーシー: ビルが　いなければ　だけどね!

key: ???: Unless Bill's around!
en: ???: Unless Bill's around!
ja: ???: ビルが　いなければ　だけどね!

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bahhh. Ain't anybody told you to respect your elders?
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bahhh. Ain't anybody told you to respect your elders?
ja: バッフロンビル: バァー。年寄りを　敬えって　誰にも　言われなかったのか?

key: ???: Bahhh. Ain't anybody told you to respect your elders?
en: ???: Bahhh. Ain't anybody told you to respect your elders?
ja: ???: バァー。年寄りを　敬えって　誰にも　言われなかったのか?

key: ALDUOUS: You think she'd be out here if they had?
en: ALDUOUS: You think she'd be out here if they had?
ja: アルドス: もし　言われてたら　彼女が　こんなとこに　いると　思うか?

key: ???: You think she'd be out here if they had?
en: ???: You think she'd be out here if they had?
ja: ???: もし　言われてたら　彼女が　こんなとこに　いると　思うか?

key: MISS PERCY: Oh, they told me...
en: MISS PERCY: Oh, they told me...
ja: パーシー: あら　言われたわよ……

key: ???: Oh, they told me...
en: ???: Oh, they told me...
ja: ???: あら　言われたわよ……

key: I just didn't listen.
en: I just didn't listen.
ja: ただ　聞かなかっただけ。

key: EUROPA: You see?
en: EUROPA: You see?
ja: エウロパ: な?

key: Call it our way of keepin' sane up here.
en: Call it our way of keepin' sane up here.
ja: これが　ここで　正気を保つ　あたしたちなりの方法さ。

key: Well, well. We don't get many new faces around here.
en: Well, well. We don't get many new faces around here.
ja: おやおや。ここいらじゃ　新顔なんて　めったに　見ねぇな。

key: Just call me Bouffalant Bill.
en: Just call me Bouffalant Bill.
ja: バッフロンビルと　呼んでくれ。

key: You need anythin', I just might be able to hook you on up.
en: You need anythin', I just might be able to hook you on up.
ja: 何か　必要なら　都合を　つけられるかも　しれねぇぜ。

key: Ain' no shortage of odds and ends we been salvaged from the supply trains 'round here.
en: Ain' no shortage of odds and ends we been salvaged from the supply trains 'round here.
ja: このあたりの　補給列車から　救い出してきた　がらくたなら　いくらでも　あるからな。

key: Gimme a holler if you wanna see what I got.
en: Gimme a holler if you wanna see what I got.
ja: 何が　あるか　見たけりゃ　声を　かけてくれ。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: You wanna know how I got my name?
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: You wanna know how I got my name?
ja: バッフロンビル: この名前の　由来　知りたいか?

key: It all started back when my nanny still lived out on Route 1--
en: It all started back when my nanny still lived out on Route 1--
ja: あれは　まだ　ばあさんが　1番道路に　住んでた頃の話でよ――

key: EUROPA: Oh, Bill, not this one again.
en: EUROPA: Oh, Bill, not this one again.
ja: エウロパ: あーもう　ビル　またその話かい。

key: ???: Oh, Bill, not this one again.
en: ???: Oh, Bill, not this one again.
ja: ???: あーもう　ビル　またその話かい。

key: We've all heard about how you exploded the bubblegum machine with just a toothpick and Bouffalant's molar like ten dozen times!
en: We've all heard about how you exploded the bubblegum machine with just a toothpick and Bouffalant's molar like ten dozen times!
ja: あんたが　つまようじと　バッフロンの奥歯だけで　ガムの自販機を　爆発させた話　もう百回は　聞いたよ!

key: Give it a rest already.
en: Give it a rest already.
ja: いい加減　休ませとくれ。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bah... Anyway, you here to buy somethin' or what?
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bah... Anyway, you here to buy somethin' or what?
ja: バッフロンビル: バァ……　まあいい　何か　買いに　来たのか?

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Money don't do you too much good out here. Might as well buy somethin'!
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Money don't do you too much good out here. Might as well buy somethin'!
ja: バッフロンビル: ここじゃ　金なんて　あんまり　役に立たねぇ。だったら　何か　買っちまいな!

key: ALDUOUS: Hey Bill, don't you go short-changin' our guest or nothin'.
en: ALDUOUS: Hey Bill, don't you go short-changin' our guest or nothin'.
ja: アルドス: おいビル　客を　だますような真似は　するんじゃねぇぞ。

key: ???: Hey Bill, don't you go short-changin' our guest or nothin'.
en: ???: Hey Bill, don't you go short-changin' our guest or nothin'.
ja: ???: おいビル　客を　だますような真似は　するんじゃねぇぞ。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bahh, you don't know what you talkin' about.
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Bahh, you don't know what you talkin' about.
ja: バッフロンビル: バァ　何を　言ってやがる。

key: Hey there, welcome to Train Town!
en: Hey there, welcome to Train Town!
ja: よう　トレインタウンへ　ようこそ!

key: Name's Alduous. Al for short is fine.
en: Name's Alduous. Al for short is fine.
ja: 名前は　アルドス。アルって　呼んでくれて　いいぜ。

key: I suppose you already met my wife, Europa?
en: I suppose you already met my wife, Europa?
ja: もう　女房の　エウロパには　会ったか?

key: The two of us got a little stir-crazy cooped up in the city, so we decided to hoof it out here and see what kind of adventure we could make.
en: The two of us got a little stir-crazy cooped up in the city, so we decided to hoof it out here and see what kind of adventure we could make.
ja: 二人とも　都会に　閉じこもってて　息が　詰まっちまってよ　ここまで　出てきて　何か　おもしれえことが　できねえか　試してみたのさ。

key: In the end, we never wanted to go back.
en: In the end, we never wanted to go back.
ja: 結局　戻る気なんて　これっぽっちも　なくなっちまった。

key: Over time we've picked up a few stragglers here and there-- mostly people lookin' to escape the city themselves.
en: Over time we've picked up a few stragglers here and there-- mostly people lookin' to escape the city themselves.
ja: そのうち　あちこちで　はぐれ者を　何人か　拾うようになってな――　たいていは　都会から　逃げてきた連中さ。

key: For instance, Miss Percy?
en: For instance, Miss Percy?
ja: たとえば　パーシーさんとか?

key: We found her collapsed out in the desert.
en: We found her collapsed out in the desert.
ja: 砂漠で　倒れてるとこを　見つけたんだ。

key: MISS PERCY: I was just taking a nap.
en: MISS PERCY: I was just taking a nap.
ja: パーシー: ちょっと　昼寝してただけよ。

key: ???: I was just taking a nap.
en: ???: I was just taking a nap.
ja: ???: ちょっと　昼寝してただけよ。

key: ALDUOUS: Face down in the middle of a sandstorm?
en: ALDUOUS: Face down in the middle of a sandstorm?
ja: アルドス: 砂嵐の真っただ中で　うつぶせになってか?

key: MISS PERCY: I didn't say it was a well-planned nap...
en: MISS PERCY: I didn't say it was a well-planned nap...
ja: パーシー: 計画的な昼寝だったとは　言ってないでしょ……

key: ???: I didn't say it was a well-planned nap...
en: ???: I didn't say it was a well-planned nap...
ja: ???: 計画的な昼寝だったとは　言ってないでしょ……

key: ALDUOUS: Anyway, I hope you'll make yourself at home here.
en: ALDUOUS: Anyway, I hope you'll make yourself at home here.
ja: アルドス: とにかく　ここじゃ　くつろいでくれよな。

key: If you need anything, you let my wife or I know.
en: If you need anything, you let my wife or I know.
ja: 何か　必要なら　女房か　おれに　言ってくれ。

key: ALDUOUS: Feel free to pull up a seat and get comfy.
en: ALDUOUS: Feel free to pull up a seat and get comfy.
ja: アルドス: 遠慮なく　座って　くつろいでくれ。

key: Our ragtag gang is always open to new company.
en: Our ragtag gang is always open to new company.
ja: うちの寄せ集め連中は　いつでも　新しい仲間を　歓迎してるんだ。

key: The group is pretty much just those you see here, plus the Stephoscope, one other guy, and sometimes Miss Titania.
en: The group is pretty much just those you see here, plus the Stephoscope, one other guy, and sometimes Miss Titania.
ja: メンバーは　だいたい　ここにいる連中と　あとは　ステフォスコープに　もう一人　それに　たまに　ティタニアさんが　来るくらいだ。

key: She only stays to chat on occasion, but she does look out for us, bringing us food and drink from the city whenever she comes in.
en: She only stays to chat on occasion, but she does look out for us, bringing us food and drink from the city whenever she comes in.
ja: たまに　顔を　出して　話していく程度だが　来るたびに　都会から　食料や　飲み物を　持ってきて　面倒を　見てくれるんだ。

key: MISS PERCY: And if we ever have trouble with the wild Pokémon, she beats them back for us!
en: MISS PERCY: And if we ever have trouble with the wild Pokémon, she beats them back for us!
ja: パーシー: それに　野生ポケモンで　困ったときは　彼女が　追い払ってくれるのよ!

key: ???: And if we ever have trouble with the wild Pokémon, she beats them back for us!
en: ???: And if we ever have trouble with the wild Pokémon, she beats them back for us!
ja: ???: それに　野生ポケモンで　困ったときは　彼女が　追い払ってくれるのよ!

key: She also said if my ex ever shows up here that she'd protect me and take him down!
en: She also said if my ex ever shows up here that she'd protect me and take him down!
ja: あたしの元カレが　ここに　現れたら　守って　やっつけてやるって　言ってくれたし!

key: In the end, she's pretty cool, right?
en: In the end, she's pretty cool, right?
ja: 結局のところ　あの人　かなり　かっこいいと　思わない?

key: Hey, you think she's interested in other women?
en: Hey, you think she's interested in other women?
ja: ねえ　あの人って　女の子に　興味　あると思う?

key: EUROPA: Percy, how much you had to drink?
en: EUROPA: Percy, how much you had to drink?
ja: エウロパ: パーシー　どんだけ　飲んだんだい?

key: ???: Percy, how much you had to drink?
en: ???: Percy, how much you had to drink?
ja: ???: パーシー　どんだけ　飲んだんだい?

key: MISS PERCY: Not enough!
en: MISS PERCY: Not enough!
ja: パーシー: 足りないくらいよ!

key: Hey there, stranger!
en: Hey there, stranger!
ja: よう　見ない顔だね!

key: Name's Percy.
en: Name's Percy.
ja: パーシーだよ。

key: Nobody sent you, right?
en: Nobody sent you, right?
ja: 誰かに　差し向けられたわけじゃ　ないよね?

key: Cuz lemme tell you, if you're here to cause trouble, you're gonna have to deal with Bouffalant Bill,
en: Cuz lemme tell you, if you're here to cause trouble, you're gonna have to deal with Bouffalant Bill,
ja: だって　もし　厄介事を　起こしに　来たんなら　バッフロンビルの　相手を　しなきゃ　いけないんだから。

key: And just in case you haven't noticed, he's got a meaaan right armpit stank.
en: And just in case you haven't noticed, he's got a meaaan right armpit stank.
ja: それに　気づいてないかもしれないけど　あいつの右のわきの下　とんでもなく　臭いんだから。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Percy, the hell you sayin'?
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Percy, the hell you sayin'?
ja: バッフロンビル: パーシー　てめえ　何　言ってやがる?

key: ???: Percy, the hell you sayin'?
en: ???: Percy, the hell you sayin'?
ja: ???: パーシー　てめえ　何　言ってやがる?

key: MISS PERCY: Gottem!
en: MISS PERCY: Gottem!
ja: パーシー: 引っかかったわね!

key: EUROPA: Well, Bill, it's hard to say she's wrong.
en: EUROPA: Well, Bill, it's hard to say she's wrong.
ja: エウロパ: まあ　ビル　あながち　間違っちゃ　いないだろ。

key: ???: Well, Bill, it's hard to say she's wrong.
en: ???: Well, Bill, it's hard to say she's wrong.
ja: ???: まあ　ビル　あながち　間違っちゃ　いないだろ。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Well excuuuse me, why don't I just go hop on into the nearest river-- oh, wait.
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Well excuuuse me, why don't I just go hop on into the nearest river-- oh, wait.
ja: バッフロンビル: あーそうかい　悪かったな　だったら　一番近い川にでも　飛び込んでやろうか――　って　あ。

key: ???: Well excuuuse me, why don't I just go hop on into the nearest river-- oh, wait.
en: ???: Well excuuuse me, why don't I just go hop on into the nearest river-- oh, wait.
ja: ???: あーそうかい　悪かったな　だったら　一番近い川にでも　飛び込んでやろうか――　って　あ。

key: MISS PERCY: Don't worry, Bill, I'll hold you under!
en: MISS PERCY: Don't worry, Bill, I'll hold you under!
ja: パーシー: 心配しないで　ビル　あたしが　沈めて　あげるから!

key: ALDUOUS: Percy, no.
en: ALDUOUS: Percy, no.
ja: アルドス: パーシー　やめとけ。

key: ???: Percy, no.
en: ???: Percy, no.
ja: ???: パーシー　やめとけ。

key: MISS PERCY: You know this is the place to be!
en: MISS PERCY: You know this is the place to be!
ja: パーシー: ここが　一番の　場所だって　わかってるくせに!

key: Reborn City who?!
en: Reborn City who?!
ja: リボーンシティ?　なにそれ?!

key: We've got the raddest crew in the region! Whoo!
en: We've got the raddest crew in the region! Whoo!
ja: この地方で　一番　イカした仲間が　ここに　いるんだから! フー!

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Settle down there or you gonna fall right off that train.
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Settle down there or you gonna fall right off that train.
ja: バッフロンビル: 落ち着けって　じゃないと　列車から　転げ落ちるぞ。

key: ???: Settle down there or you gonna fall right off that train.
en: ???: Settle down there or you gonna fall right off that train.
ja: ???: 落ち着けって　じゃないと　列車から　転げ落ちるぞ。

key: MISS PERCY: Pshaww, it's cool, we've got a doctor in the house.
en: MISS PERCY: Pshaww, it's cool, we've got a doctor in the house.
ja: パーシー: へっ　平気よ　うちには　お医者様が　いるんだから。

key: Even if she's too much of a party-pooper to actually come socialize.
en: Even if she's too much of a party-pooper to actually come socialize.
ja: まあ　付き合い悪すぎて　全然　こっちに　来てくれないけどね。

key: EUROPA: No need to be cold about it though, you hear?
en: EUROPA: No need to be cold about it though, you hear?
ja: エウロパ: そんな　冷たい言い方　しなくても　いいだろ?

key: ???: No need to be cold about it though, you hear?
en: ???: No need to be cold about it though, you hear?
ja: ???: そんな　冷たい言い方　しなくても　いいだろ?

key: If'n I rightly recall, you was pretty timid of us your own self after you came here.
en: If'n I rightly recall, you was pretty timid of us your own self after you came here.
ja: 確か　あんたも　ここに　来たばかりの頃は　あたしらのこと　かなり　怖がってたはずだよ。

key: Now look at you.
en: Now look at you.
ja: それが　今じゃ　この様さ。

key: And it hasn't been all that long since she came here.
en: And it hasn't been all that long since she came here.
ja: それに　彼女が　ここに　来てから　そんなに　経っちゃ　いないんだ。

key: Besides, I'm not so sure she's actually a doctor...
en: Besides, I'm not so sure she's actually a doctor...
ja: だいたい　彼女が　本当に　医者なのかも　怪しいもんだしね……

key: MISS PERCY: Still, at least I talked to you guys at all!
en: MISS PERCY: Still, at least I talked to you guys at all!
ja: パーシー: それでも　あたしは　ちゃんと　みんなと　話してるでしょ!

key: But it's like little miss Stephoscope over there doesn't want to even try.
en: But it's like little miss Stephoscope over there doesn't want to even try.
ja: でも　あそこの　ステフォスコープちゃんは　やる気すら　なさそうじゃない。

key: EUROPA: She'll try when she's ready, Percy.
en: EUROPA: She'll try when she's ready, Percy.
ja: エウロパ: 準備が　できたら　やる気に　なるさ　パーシー。

key: ???: She'll try when she's ready, Percy.
en: ???: She'll try when she's ready, Percy.
ja: ???: 準備が　できたら　やる気に　なるさ　パーシー。

key: Ain't no two ways about it.
en: Ain't no two ways about it.
ja: それしか　ないんだよ。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, my dashing dame, you have returned to me at last!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, my dashing dame, you have returned to me at last!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ああ　我が麗しの淑女よ　ついに　私の元へ　戻ってきてくれたか!

key: A most dear delight, for today, I have a special unveiling planned just for you!
en: A most dear delight, for today, I have a special unveiling planned just for you!
ja: 実に　喜ばしいことに　今日は　君だけのために　特別な披露を　用意してあるのだ!

key: CORIN-ROUGE: There you are.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: There you are.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: そこに　いたか。

key: I'd like to tell you about myself.
en: I'd like to tell you about myself.
ja: 私自身のことを　話したいんだ。

key: Whether it is the sands, some other force, or just the sheer amount of shrapnel-tumbleweed already scrapped around here,
en: Whether it is the sands, some other force, or just the sheer amount of shrapnel-tumbleweed already scrapped around here,
ja: この砂のせいなのか　それとも　何か別の力なのか　あるいは　ここに　すでに　積み重なった　がらくたの山の　せいなのか――

key: Something about this place has a habit of pulling others in.
en: Something about this place has a habit of pulling others in.
ja: この場所には　何か　人を　引き寄せる　癖が　あるようだ。

key: Sometimes through full trains at a time.
en: Sometimes through full trains at a time.
ja: 時には　列車一台分　まるごとね。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: I was just coming to the Reborn Region via train when something went wrong.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: I was just coming to the Reborn Region via train when something went wrong.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: 私は　列車で　リボーン地方へ　向かっている途中で　何かが　狂ったんだ。

key: I lost everything.
en: I lost everything.
ja: すべてを　失った。

key: Many people around me died.
en: Many people around me died.
ja: 周りの多くの人が　亡くなった。

key: I was remarkably lucky, so I did what I could for the survivors. They could not move far.
en: I was remarkably lucky, so I did what I could for the survivors. They could not move far.
ja: 私は　驚くほど運が良くてね　生存者のために　できることを　した。彼らは　遠くまで　動けなかった。

key: I found one of the less damaged cars further into this rat's nest and pulled them in.
en: I found one of the less damaged cars further into this rat's nest and pulled them in.
ja: このがらくたの巣の奥で　比較的　損傷の少ない車両を　見つけて　そこへ　彼らを　引き入れたんだ。

key: There, I did what I could for them. But with no money, medicine or food, my options were as limited as their time.
en: There, I did what I could for them. But with no money, medicine or food, my options were as limited as their time.
ja: そこで　できる限りのことは　したが　金も　薬も　食料も　なく　選択肢は　彼らに　残された時間と同じくらい　限られていた。

key: The time it would take to receive a paycheck would have been too late.
en: The time it would take to receive a paycheck would have been too late.
ja: 給料が　振り込まれるのを　待っていたんじゃ　間に合わなかった。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: That was when I began stealing.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: That was when I began stealing.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: そこで　私は　盗みを　始めたんだ。

key: I just needed to help the others get by.
en: I just needed to help the others get by.
ja: ただ　みんなが　生き延びる手助けが　したかっただけだ。

key: Some of them didn't.
en: Some of them didn't.
ja: 生き延びられなかった者も　いた。

key: Others made a full recovery and went on to lead the lives they came here for.
en: Others made a full recovery and went on to lead the lives they came here for.
ja: 完全に　回復して　ここに　来た目的通りの人生を　歩んだ者も　いた。

key: Some stayed here, and in time left.
en: Some stayed here, and in time left.
ja: ここに　留まって　やがて　去っていった者も　いる。

key: Since then, there've always been people here, though the faces change with the seasons.
en: Since then, there've always been people here, though the faces change with the seasons.
ja: それ以来　顔ぶれは　季節ごとに　変わっても　ここには　いつも　誰かが　いるんだ。

key: Fugitives... Refugees... Sinners and those who have been sinned against...
en: Fugitives... Refugees... Sinners and those who have been sinned against...
ja: 逃亡者……　難民……　罪を犯した者と　罪を　犯された者……

key: Everyone is equal here, but always wanting by necessity.
en: Everyone is equal here, but always wanting by necessity.
ja: ここでは　誰もが　平等だが　必要に迫られて　いつも　何かを　求めている。

key: I've done what I could just to deliver.
en: I've done what I could just to deliver.
ja: 私は　ただ　それに　応えるために　できることを　してきた。

key: In time, necessity became skill.
en: In time, necessity became skill.
ja: やがて　必要は　技術に　変わった。

key: Skill became renown.
en: Skill became renown.
ja: 技術は　名声に　変わった。

key: Now it's almost too dangerous for me to try anything else.
en: Now it's almost too dangerous for me to try anything else.
ja: 今では　他のことに　手を出すのは　危険すぎるくらいだ。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Even now, there are people here who need protection.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Even now, there are people here who need protection.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: 今でも　ここには　守りを　必要とする人たちが　いる。

key: I wanted to be able to offer them that protection too.
en: I wanted to be able to offer them that protection too.
ja: 私は　彼らにも　その守りを　与えられるように　なりたかった。

key: That was why I had to steal your ultimate Pokémon.
en: That was why I had to steal your ultimate Pokémon.
ja: だからこそ　君の　究極のポケモンを　盗む必要が　あったんだ。

key: Nothing personal.
en: Nothing personal.
ja: 個人的な恨みは　何もない。

key: I haven't even had time to do anything with it between evading you and the police, and gathering other supplies.
en: I haven't even had time to do anything with it between evading you and the police, and gathering other supplies.
ja: 君や　警察から　逃げながら　他の物資を　集める間　それを　どうこうする時間すら　なかった。

key: But I hope you understand now--
en: But I hope you understand now--
ja: だが　これで　わかってもらえたと　思う――

key: I can't just give this back.
en: I can't just give this back.
ja: これを　簡単に　返すわけには　いかないんだ。

key: This place is my home.
en: This place is my home.
ja: この場所は　私の家なんだ。

key: So, even if it pits me against a brilliant angel such as yourself...
en: So, even if it pits me against a brilliant angel such as yourself...
ja: だから　たとえ　君のような　輝ける天使を　敵に回すことに　なろうとも……

key: I will protect it!
en: I will protect it!
ja: 私は　これを　守ってみせる!
私は……

key: CORIN-ROUGE: ...
en: CORIN-ROUGE: ...
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ……

key: CORIN-ROUGE: I'll just go turn myself in now.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: I'll just go turn myself in now.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: もう　自首しに　行くとするよ。

key: ???: Well, howdy, partners!
en: ???: Well, howdy, partners!
ja: ???: いやあ　こんにちは　お二人さん!

key: TAKA: Uhh, nope. No Steelix.
en: TAKA: Uhh, nope. No Steelix.
ja: タカ: いや　違いますよ。ハガネールじゃ　ないです。

key: Just two crazy people with a train.
en: Just two crazy people with a train.
ja: ただの　列車を持った　変わり者二人組です。

key: ???: Well, you know we all been there.
en: ???: Well, you know we all been there.
ja: ???: まあ　誰だって　そんな時期は　あるもんさ。

key: Some good ol' fashioned train-joustin' is the best sport we got out here!
en: Some good ol' fashioned train-joustin' is the best sport we got out here!
ja: 昔ながらの　列車ジョウストが　ここいらじゃ　最高のスポーツだからな!

key: TAKA: That sounds safe.
en: TAKA: That sounds safe.
ja: タカ: それ　安全そうですね。

key: ???: Anyway, my name's Europa!
en: ???: Anyway, my name's Europa!
ja: ???: とにかく　あたしの名前は　エウロパだ!

key: Y'all lookin' for a place to rest?
en: Y'all lookin' for a place to rest?
ja: 休める場所を　探してるのかい?

key: TAKA: Rest? I don't think I've heard of that before.
en: TAKA: Rest? I don't think I've heard of that before.
ja: タカ: 休む?　そんな言葉　聞いたこと　ないです。

key: EUROPA: Ohh, you joker!
en: EUROPA: Ohh, you joker!
ja: エウロパ: おっと　冗談言うじゃないか!

key: We don't exactly get a lot of visitors out here, but there's a few of us who hang together for our own reasons.
en: We don't exactly get a lot of visitors out here, but there's a few of us who hang together for our own reasons.
ja: ここいらじゃ　来客なんて　そう多くないけど　それぞれの事情で　集まってる連中が　何人か　いるんだ。

key: Some of us are chasin' peace, others fleein' violence.
en: Some of us are chasin' peace, others fleein' violence.
ja: 平穏を　求めてる者も　いれば　暴力から　逃げてきた者も　いる。

key: It don't matter who you are though, you're welcome to stay with us as long as you like.
en: It don't matter who you are though, you're welcome to stay with us as long as you like.
ja: でも　あんたが　誰であろうと　好きなだけ　あたしらと　一緒に　いていいんだ。

key: We got each other here, and that's all we need.
en: We got each other here, and that's all we need.
ja: ここじゃ　お互いが　いれば　それで　十分さ。

key: TAKA: This... might work out.
en: TAKA: This... might work out.
ja: タカ: これは……　うまくいくかも　しれません。

key: EUROPA: Y'all got a story to tell?
en: EUROPA: Y'all got a story to tell?
ja: エウロパ: あんたら　語れる話でも　あるのかい?

key: TAKA: \PN probably has several.
en: TAKA: \PN probably has several.
ja: タカ: \PNは　きっと　いくつも　あると思います。

key: And I uh...
en: And I uh...
ja: 僕は　その……

key: I'm just looking for somewhere safe.
en: I'm just looking for somewhere safe.
ja: ただ　安全な場所を　探してるだけです。

key: EUROPA: Well, congrats! You found it!
en: EUROPA: Well, congrats! You found it!
ja: エウロパ: そりゃ　おめでとう! 見つけたじゃないか!

key: If'n you'd like, I can set you up with one of your own personal trains and what few accommodations we've got.
en: If'n you'd like, I can set you up with one of your own personal trains and what few accommodations we've got.
ja: よければ　あんた専用の列車と　ここに　あるわずかな設備を　用意してやるよ。

key: TAKA: So-- wait, you guys just, live in the trains out here?
en: TAKA: So-- wait, you guys just, live in the trains out here?
ja: タカ: つまり――　待ってください　みなさん　この列車で　暮らしてるんですか?

key: Cuz you can?
en: Cuz you can?
ja: できるから　って　だけで?

key: EUROPA: Pretty much!
en: EUROPA: Pretty much!
ja: エウロパ: だいたい　そんなとこだね!

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: Yeah, sounds great.
en: Yeah, sounds great.
ja: いいですね　それ。

key: If it's no trouble, that'd be... a big relief.
en: If it's no trouble, that'd be... a big relief.
ja: ご迷惑でなければ　その……　すごく　助かります。

key: EUROPA: Well, right this way, sir!
en: EUROPA: Well, right this way, sir!
ja: エウロパ: さあ　こっちだよ!

key: EUROPA: Well, this here's it.
en: EUROPA: Well, this here's it.
ja: エウロパ: さて　ここだよ。

key: Ain't much in the way of amenities, but it'll keep you out the sand.
en: Ain't much in the way of amenities, but it'll keep you out the sand.
ja: 設備は　大したこと　ないけど　砂よけには　なるさ。

key: EUROPA: He your boyfriend or somethin'?
en: EUROPA: He your boyfriend or somethin'?
ja: エウロパ: そいつ　あんたの　彼氏か何かかい?

key: EUROPA: Oh, I'm just playin' with ya.
en: EUROPA: Oh, I'm just playin' with ya.
ja: エウロパ: おっと　ただの　からかいだよ。

key: But if you lookin' to stay too, the two of you can share, or I'm sure we can find you another car.
en: But if you lookin' to stay too, the two of you can share, or I'm sure we can find you another car.
ja: でも　あんたも　泊まりたいなら　二人で　一緒でも　いいし　別の車両を　探してやってもいいよ。

key: EUROPA: If you lookin' to stay too, the two of you can share, or I'm sure we can find you another car.
en: EUROPA: If you lookin' to stay too, the two of you can share, or I'm sure we can find you another car.
ja: エウロパ: あんたも　泊まりたいなら　二人で　一緒でも　いいし　別の車両を　探してやってもいいよ。

key: EUROPA: What do you think?
en: EUROPA: What do you think?
ja: エウロパ: どう　思う?

key: Certainly needs some TLC, but with a good broom and a bit of elbow grease, should be all hunky-dory.
en: Certainly needs some TLC, but with a good broom and a bit of elbow grease, should be all hunky-dory.
ja: 確かに　手入れは　必要だけど　ちゃんと　ほうきを　かけて　ひと汗かけば　すぐに　快適に　なるはずさ。

key: AMARIA: And you're officially all set!
en: AMARIA: And you're officially all set!
ja: アマリア: これで　正式に　準備完了だね!

key: STEPHOSCOPE: Now we can really begin making some developments around here.
en: STEPHOSCOPE: Now we can really begin making some developments around here.
ja: ステフォスコープ: これで　やっと　この辺りの開発を　本格的に　始められますね。

key: MISS PERCY: Well, thank whatever divine creature rules above these days and all their kin.
en: MISS PERCY: Well, thank whatever divine creature rules above these days and all their kin.
ja: パーシー: ああ　今どき　上を　治めてる神様やら　その一族やら　誰でもいいから　感謝するわ。

key: No more supply hikes just for water!
en: No more supply hikes just for water!
ja: 水を　くみに　わざわざ　遠出しなくて　いいのね!

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: No more sponge baths!
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: No more sponge baths!
ja: バッフロンビル: もう　スポンジ入浴とも　おさらばだ!

key: ALDUOUS: I'd kind of gotten used to the sponge baths.
en: ALDUOUS: I'd kind of gotten used to the sponge baths.
ja: アルドス: おれは　スポンジ入浴にも　ちょっと　慣れてきてたんだがな。

key: EUROPA: No more sponge baths, and that's an order.
en: EUROPA: No more sponge baths, and that's an order.
ja: エウロパ: スポンジ入浴は　もう　なし　これは　命令だよ。

key: ALDUOUS: Yes ma'am.
en: ALDUOUS: Yes ma'am.
ja: アルドス: はい　奥様。

key: EUROPA: Thanks again for doing this for us, Miss Amaria.
en: EUROPA: Thanks again for doing this for us, Miss Amaria.
ja: エウロパ: アマリアさん　改めて　ありがとうな　こんなことまで　してくれて。

key: AMARIA: It's no trouble at all!
en: AMARIA: It's no trouble at all!
ja: アマリア: 全然　大したことないよ!

key: AMARIA: Okay, well, that's a lie.
en: AMARIA: Okay, well, that's a lie.
ja: アマリア: ま　それは　ウソだけどね。

key: Cutting through all that stone was a ton of trouble; there's no way I could've done it without \PN's help.
en: Cutting through all that stone was a ton of trouble; there's no way I could've done it without \PN's help.
ja: あの岩を　全部　削るの　本当に　大変だったし\PNの　手伝いが　なかったら　絶対　無理だったよ。

key: But!
en: But!
ja: でも!

key: It was worth it.
en: It was worth it.
ja: やる価値は　あったね。

key: MISS PERCY: Well, who's up for some celebratory drinks!?
en: MISS PERCY: Well, who's up for some celebratory drinks!?
ja: パーシー: さて　お祝いに　一杯　いきたい人は?!

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Only if you mean booze!
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Only if you mean booze!
ja: バッフロンビル: 酒のことなら　もちろん　乗るぜ!

key: MISS PERCY: Of course I mean booze!
en: MISS PERCY: Of course I mean booze!
ja: パーシー: もちろん　酒に　決まってるでしょ!

key: What else are we gonna drink, this pristine water we now have freely available to all of us?!
en: What else are we gonna drink, this pristine water we now have freely available to all of us?!
ja: 他に　何を　飲むって言うのよ　みんなが　自由に使える　このきれいな水?!

key: As if!
en: As if!
ja: なんてな!

key: I'll drink you under the proverbial table!
en: I'll drink you under the proverbial table!
ja: とことん　飲んで　あんたを　酔いつぶして　やるんだから!

key: BOUFFALANT: Hah! Big words from a small lass.
en: BOUFFALANT: Hah! Big words from a small lass.
ja: バッフロンビル: はっ! ちっこいねえちゃんが　大きく出たな。

key: MISS PERCY: Alduous! Get the bottle!
en: MISS PERCY: Alduous! Get the bottle!
ja: パーシー: アルドス! ボトル　持ってきて!

key: ALDUOUS: All right, hold your Horseas...
en: ALDUOUS: All right, hold your Horseas...
ja: アルドス: わかった　わかった　落ち着けって……

key: EUROPA: Well, someone'd better go make sure everybody keeps their knickers on.
en: EUROPA: Well, someone'd better go make sure everybody keeps their knickers on.
ja: エウロパ: さてと　誰か　みんなが　ちゃんと　服を　着てるか　見張っといたほうが　いいね。

key: Once again, we really appreciate all this.
en: Once again, we really appreciate all this.
ja: 改めて　本当に　感謝してるよ　これ全部。

key: You're welcome here any time, Miss Amaria.
en: You're welcome here any time, Miss Amaria.
ja: アマリアさん　いつでも　ここに　来ていいからね。

key: AMARIA: Please, just Amy is fine.
en: AMARIA: Please, just Amy is fine.
ja: アマリア: お願い　エイミーで　いいよ。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: We should install a covering to prevent evaporation posthaste...
en: STEPHOSCOPE: We should install a covering to prevent evaporation posthaste...
ja: ステフォスコープ: 蒸発を　防ぐための　覆いを　早急に　設置すべきですね……

key: AMARIA: Hey.
en: AMARIA: Hey.
ja: アマリア: ねえ。

key: You should go celebrate too.
en: You should go celebrate too.
ja: あなたも　お祝いに　行くべきだよ。

key: You worked hard for this.
en: You worked hard for this.
ja: 頑張ったんだから。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: Ah... But there's still so much to do.
en: STEPHOSCOPE: Ah... But there's still so much to do.
ja: ステフォスコープ: ああ……　でも　まだ　やることが　たくさん　あって。

key: AMARIA: Sure,
en: AMARIA: Sure,
ja: アマリア: そうだね

key: But also, if not now, then when?
en: But also, if not now, then when?
ja: でも　今じゃ　なかったら　いつやるの?

key: It's important to let yourself appreciate the little things.
en: It's important to let yourself appreciate the little things.
ja: 小さなことにも　ちゃんと　目を　向けるのって　大事だよ。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: ...
en: STEPHOSCOPE: ...
ja: ステフォスコープ: ……

key: ...Perhaps, just for a little while.
en: ...Perhaps, just for a little while.
ja: ……少しの間だけなら。

key: AMARIA: Thanks again.
en: AMARIA: Thanks again.
ja: アマリア: 改めて　ありがとう。

key: You know, no matter how low I may get sometimes,
en: You know, no matter how low I may get sometimes,
ja: あのね　あたしも　時々　すごく　落ち込むことが　あるけど

key: I find that doing something for others always helps me out too.
en: I find that doing something for others always helps me out too.
ja: 誰かのために　何かすることって　結局　自分の助けにも　なるんだよね。

key: Maybe that's selfish of me, but...
en: Maybe that's selfish of me, but...
ja: それって　自分勝手なのかも　しれないけど……

key: As long as some good comes of it,
en: As long as some good comes of it,
ja: それで　何か　いいことが　生まれるなら

key: Then maybe that's okay.
en: Then maybe that's okay.
ja: それで　いいのかも。

key: Maybe I'm okay.
en: Maybe I'm okay.
ja: あたしも　これで　いいのかも。

key: And it definitely helps to be out of the house!
en: And it definitely helps to be out of the house!
ja: それに　家を　出るのは　絶対　いい気分転換に　なるし!

key: Especially now that there are some signs of water damage in the main room...
en: Especially now that there are some signs of water damage in the main room...
ja: 特に　今　メインルームに　水漏れの跡が　出てきてるし……

key: I probably should've thought about that sooner, but...
en: I probably should've thought about that sooner, but...
ja: もっと　早く　考えとくべきだったんだろうけど……

key: I don't think I would've changed it.
en: I don't think I would've changed it.
ja: たぶん　何も　変えなかったと　思う。

key: Maybe in the end I'll just sell the property and go traveling.
en: Maybe in the end I'll just sell the property and go traveling.
ja: 結局　この家を　売って　旅にでも　出ようかな。

key: See what I see.
en: See what I see.
ja: 自分の目で　いろんなものを　見てみる。

key: Seek out some moments to make it hard to get too caught up in myself.
en: Seek out some moments to make it hard to get too caught up in myself.
ja: 自分のことばかり　考えすぎないで　済むような瞬間を　探しに行く。

key: AMARIA: Wanna come with me?
en: AMARIA: Wanna come with me?
ja: アマリア: 一緒に　来る?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
